scientific_question: For the exact 14 Q4_K FFN-down decode nodes, does changing only work decomposition from the current serial-K kernel to the already-qualified native subgroup32 split-K kernel causally reduce Q4-down component latency, and does that reduction carry through to decode and E2E latency?

token_xray_phase2.finding: FFN-down accounts for 16.27% of Phase-2 dispatch time; split-K gate/up provides an internal positive control.

directional_only: Q4-down SBID stall ~55% versus split-K Q4 control ~4.5-5.4%.
Q4-down ALU1 utilization ~11% versus split-K Q4 control ~87%.

existing_child_A.note: Reuse only the already-frozen Child-A work-decomposition intervention; materialization arms B/AB are out of scope.

isolation_contract: Only the 14 exact Q4_K FFN-down decode dispatches may differ between arm 0 and arm A.
Weights, source bytes, tensor offsets, Q4_K representation, shapes and push constants are identical.
All 14 Q6_K FFN-down nodes remain unchanged.
Gate/up remain the already-established split-K implementation in both arms.
Q/K/V/O, attention, norms, embedding, LM-head and prefill remain unchanged.
No materialization, reordering, extra resident execution image, fusion, width search or additional mechanism is allowed.
Both arms execute the same prompts, token feedback policy and 32 generated tokens.

component_probe.input: same deterministic fixed FFN activation vector for both arms

timing_campaign.warmup: one full unmeasured inference per arm before block 0

carry.note: No Vulkan timestamp queries in carry runs.

component.primary_metric: sum of timestamp ticks over exactly 14 Q4-down dispatches
component.note: Component run is separate from carry run; its wall-clock timing is never used for carry-through.

adjudication.component_supported: For both workloads, paired A/0 component-tick ratio 95% CI upper bound < 1.
adjudication.decode_carry_supported: For both workloads, paired A/0 decode-ms ratio 95% CI upper bound < 1.
adjudication.e2e_carry_supported: For both workloads, paired A/0 E2E-ms ratio 95% CI upper bound < 1.

authorization.reason: Implementation and zero-science QA may proceed. Real-model correctness must independently PASS before a separate performance authorization.
